remarks: 3892 Gaines Basin Road is located in the Town of Albion offering a country setting on 1.67 acres of land.  Perfect for Homesteading.  And yet close enough to schools and shopping.  This ranch home offers 2 beds/1 bath.  Updated thermal pane windows throughout.  A propane stove in the family room for those cozy evenings by the fire.  A galley style kitchen with plenty of cabinetry for storage and those weekly kitchen staples.  This home has hardwoods in the bedrooms and you'll find hardwood floors underneath the carpeted spaces, as well.  A one car garage is attached via the breezeway.   Enjoy the back deck area just off the breezeway to take in the days work in the gardens and beautiful country sunsets.  You will also find several outbuildings that can be used as well for garden tools, yard equipment etc.  An adorable cabin built by the homeowner can be used for entertaining & relaxation with a fire pit to enjoy.  And if that's not enough...there is a 36' x 34' Heated Pole Barn that comes complete with a working utility sink.  (the wood stove in barn will not convey with the sale.  It will be removed prior to closing). This is the perfect place for that handyperson or DIY'er.  This home comes fully equipped with a home generator for ease of mind during those power outages and Central Air on those hot summer days.  This home truly has so much to offer both inside and out.
